svg.title: Georeferencer - agent workflow, location model and modular tools
svg.desc: Purple boxes are LLM calls, green boxes Python processing and blue boxes external API calls. Documents are processed in chunks with forward context. The model classifies general geographic context, spatial groups and component locations. Python routes coordinate claims, places and mining assets to appropriate tools. Future permit, drilling and survey adapters are dashed. Python validates evidence before geographic review and GeoJSON output.

div.style: color: rgb(54, 53, 47) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Document
PDF / HTML / text

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PYTHON
Extract text and split into chunks

div.style: color: rgb(62, 33, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
LLM - Sol
Identify locations in this chunk
Use earlier entities and scoped geography

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON
Anchor mentions; validate claims
Merge compatible updates; retain stable IDs

div.style: color: rgb(54, 53, 47) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
LOCATION MODEL
General geographic context: country, province, reference town
Spatial group: project, region, basin or mountain range
Component location: hole, target, outcrop; references group ID
Each entity also has a role, verification type, mentions and optional coordinate claims

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON - ROUTING
Exclude irrelevant roles from resolution
Group related locations; choose tools from evidence and type

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON - DOCUMENT COORDINATES
Check quoted values and coordinate system
Convert supported coordinates

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 87) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
EXTERNAL API - GEOCODER
Photon or Nominatim
Geographic places with country / region context

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON - MATCH RECORDS
Check original identity, type and geography
Try simpler names / document aliases

div.style: color: rgb(62, 33, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
LLM - Luna
Shared refinement batch if still unsuccessful
Suggest up to 3 new queries per entity

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON - SHARED SOURCES
Check already downloaded reports first
Discovery only when evidence is insufficient

div.style: color: rgb(62, 33, 94) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LLM - Luna + web-search tool
One discovery per spatial group
Supply all candidate members

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON - RETRIEVE EVIDENCE
Download and reuse source documents
Select relevant text, table headers and CRS passages

div.style: color: rgb(62, 33, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
LLM - Sol
Interpret passages / tables in batches
Return entity-specific values and quotations

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 87) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
EXTERNAL APIs - FUTURE ADAPTERS
Permit / claim database for mineral tenure
Drilling database for drill sites
Gazetteer / survey service for places or geology

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON - OPTIONAL LOCAL REGISTRY
Read a normalized registry export
Not a live mining database connector

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON - ACCEPTANCE
Check source evidence and copied values
Convert CRS; preserve provenance; detect conflicts
Missing or ambiguous evidence stays unresolved

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON - GROUP EXTENT
BBox of resolved component locations only
Exclude general geographic context points

div.style: color: rgb(62, 33, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
LLM - Sol
Check whether the group extent is plausible
Flag suspicious points; keep their coordinates

div.style: color: rgb(23, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
PYTHON - OUTPUT
GeoJSON coordinates + complete evidence report
All entities, unresolved reasons, flags and usage
